bullets.text: Camera Kings Clash - **iPhone 17 Pro** and **Galaxy S25 Ultra** deliver impressive camera performance, but personal preference rules.
Star Wars Returns - The original 1977 theatrical cut of **Star Wars** will hit theatres again in 2027 for a limited time.
Exciting Bluetooth Feature - **Auracast** technology allows multiple devices to connect to a single source without pairing.
Apple's Festive Display - **Apple** showcases winning iPad designs as Christmas trees at **Battersea Power Station**.
iPhone Camera Update - The **iPhone 17 Pro** loses Night mode in Portrait mode, a feature from the previous model.
Pat Gelsinger's Ambitious Bet - Former **Intel** CEO aims to revive **Moore's Law** with new semiconductor technology.
Meta's Mixed Reality Delay - **Meta** pushes back the release of its mixed reality glasses to 2027.
Apple's Executive Shakeup - **Apple's** chip chief, Johny Srouji, is considering leaving amid ongoing executive changes.
Best Smart Home Devices - **Apple HomeKit** devices are on sale, making them ideal holiday gifts for tech enthusiasts.
Spotify Wrapped Fun - **Spotify** introduces a new party feature to its annual Wrapped experience for 2025.
